quest_principles: A quest becomes visible only when Jack has a legitimate reason to know the objective.
Objectives may exist in the world before Jack knows them.
Deadlines continue while Jack is elsewhere.
Failure and abandonment are persistent outcomes, not automatic resets.
NPCs pursue their own goals whether or not Jack accepts a quest.
The world does not scale or wait for Jack.
Quest rewards must come from an actor, institution, object, or system that can actually provide them.
